Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Turkish woman, an adult, in her early 20s, a subtle grimace of effort, a small crease between her brows and her jaw set just a little, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. Her face is a real living adult face, warm olive skin, smoky bronze eyes, a deep rose-nude lip, braided hair, real pores, real living eyes, smooth bare ears, wearing a single piece of gold earrings. Full body painted in Spanish Talavera de la Reina ceramic, a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre floral medallions, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the pattern reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps, wide cobalt bands following every deep crease and curving fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the densest concentration of floral medallion border wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's natural centrepiece, the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. The pattern has faded to a pale ghost over her shoulders, upper arms and the fronts of her thighs and peeled away in thin curls around her wrists, ankles and knees, so patches of her living skin show through. Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of the same links, her hands hanging low in front of her hips. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of the same links. Pose: walking slowly, her body turned in profile to the camera and her face turned toward the camera, bent far forward under the weight of the iron ball on her back, her bare feet flat on the flagstones, her whole body straining with fatigue, her pregnant belly, chest and shoulders in view, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her bare feet streaked with soot and dirt.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight. Lighting: dim torchlight and flickering firelight raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Her pregnant belly is the visible centerpiece of the frame. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
